faqs.q: Sec. 102-78. - Demolition and disconnection of existing utilities.
faqs.a:
Prior to demolition of a building on premises, including moving of a building to another
               location, an owner must request the utility billing division to turn off water and
               read the water meter. A permit to disconnect the utilities will be obtained from the
               engineering division and a permit for demolition will be obtained from the building
               inspection division. The utility disconnects will be in accordance with city engineering
               specifications. The utility service lines shall be disconnected at the main, unless
               otherwise specified in writing by the utilities manager.
(Code 1981, § 33-49; Ord. No. 2574, § 1, 11-21-1988; Ord. No. 3403, § 14, 10-20-1997)
